title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（高原利幸研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Takahara Toshiyuki)
educationalGoal:
Students will be able to:
(1) Deal with Geotechnical problem like ground motion during earthquake or estimation method of slope failure during heavy rain with topological and geo-morphological knowledge.
(2) Make clear the key points for solving problem by engineering approach such as structural analysis
(3) Propose proper solving method and explain the each process reasonably.
advice:
In the first semester, we will conduct a literature survey on the background of research themes and previousII studies, and summarize the novelty and methods of research.

In the second half, data will be collected for experiments, measurements, and numerical calculations. Analyze and consider from the data obtained from them. Summarize the results of your research in papers and presentation materials.

A total of 450 hours or more of study are required.
the each process reasonably.
requiredKnowledge: Soil Mechanics I, II, Geotechnical Analysis, Disaster Prevention Engineering II, Design/Exercise in Civil and Environmental Engineering

achievementLevels.ideal:
Acquire basic knowledge on project issues and conduct project activities through discussions with supervisors.

In the project activity, you can select and use these methods by yourself in the process of solving problems using measuring instruments and calculation tools.

The research results can be explained to engineers and non-experts.
